# EvDirection

> A panel that guides one short task: title and subtext, an optional header action, a body, and confirm / cancel footer slots.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:direction` |
| Layer | Organism (`src/organisms`) |
| Import | `import { EvDirection } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvDirection>` or `<ev-direction>` |
| Source | `src/organisms/direction/EvDirection.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<section class="ev-direction">` |

## Example

```vue
<EvDirection
  title="Lengkapi profil"
  subtext="Tiga isian lagi sebelum bisa mengajukan."
>
  Taruh isian formulir di sini.
</EvDirection>
```

_The exact snippet the playground simulator copies for this component (`playground/simulator-demos.ts`)._

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Direction**, frame `4220:76473` (Direction). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Focus the user on one guided task — a short form, a confirmation, or a step that needs a title, brief instruction, and clear primary / secondary actions.

### When not to use

- For long multi-step flows → use a full page or wizard. For passive status messages → use Alert (`evoq-ui:alert`) or Toast, not a blocking panel.

### Do

- Lead with a clear title and one-line subtext. Keep the body slot focused. Make the primary action obvious and the secondary a safe exit.

### Don't

- Don't cram many fields or steps into one panel. Don't hide the close affordance. Don't make both footer buttons look primary.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvDirection`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<section class="ev-direction">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:direction` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
